description: Source code for a dashboard widget (dashlet) class 'PipelineBySalesStageDashlet' in SuiteCRM, which generates a chart visualizing opportunities by sales stage with configurable date range and sales stages.

classes.name: PipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class extending DashletGenericChart to display a pipeline chart grouped by sales stages, with methods for constructing queries, preparing chart data, and rendering the chart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default or provided options, setting date range and title.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Configures and displays options for the dashlet, particularly sales stages.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML/JavaScript code for rendering the chart, including data retrieval and chart configuration.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the constructed SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by sales stage, ordered according to selected stages.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunity counts and totals within the specified date range.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into chart-ready format with labels, data points, and totals.

methods.name: resizeLabel
methods.description: Truncates labels exceeding a certain length, appending ellipsis.
